statement: The characteristic numbers of smooth quartics through a points and tangent to 14−a lines, ordered a=14,…,0, are 1,6,36,216,1296,7776,46656,279600,1668096,9840040,56481396,308389896,1530345504,6533946576,23011191144.

source.location: Theorem8.1 and Table7, arXiv v1 printed page24

notes:
Smooth quartics have genus3. In particular the last number is not the rational-quartic count620. General incidence conditions and proper tangencies are required.

Imported from the 2026-10-26 catalogue record R_848c12c1585006c6; the source claim has not been newly rechecked against the paper for this beta import.

Zeuthen 1873 predicted these quartic characteristic numbers; Vakil completes their rigorous verification. The prediction is historical context for the proof. Singleton real/monodromy conclusions are deductions from the count.

The following bibliography supplies historical attribution or supporting background for the result. H. G. Zeuthen, Almindelige Egenskaber ved Systemer af plane Kurver (1873, zeuthen_1873_plane_curve_systems).
scope: Smooth plane quartics through a general points and properly tangent to 14−a general lines.
